title: Tai Tam Tuk Raw Water Pumping Station No. 2 Staff Quarters
geometryBasis: The official heritage boundary identifies the monument and the separately mapped outlines locate the primary buildings. The original 5 m terrain locates the compound relative to the shoreline and adjacent slope.
sectionBasis: Two-storey L-shaped former filter house, red brick, contrasting Shanghai plaster, an upper seaward verandah and an exterior stair.
limitations: The main footprint follows the named OpenStreetMap building. The official heritage boundary establishes the immediate site and supports the location of associated minor volumes. Where no independent footprint survives, the minor-volume positions are estimates inside that area.

The main heights, eaves, paint tones and position of individual windows, stairs and service fittings are estimates from the written descriptions and mapped dimensions. Closed interiors and below-grade service rooms are outside the exterior scope.
The original 5 m terrain is preserved. Fine platform and paving geometry may differ from the survey.
The estimated threshold is 15.61 m HKPD, on the mapped hillside bench below the center of the unmodified terrain field.
